title: The IDPS must block malicious code.
check_content:
Verify the IDPS blocks malicious code.

If the IDPS does not block malicious code, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the IDPS to block malicious code.
VulnDiscussion: Configuring the IDPS to delete and/or quarantine based on local organizational incident handling procedures minimizes the impact of this code on the network.
